title: Divergence: RATIONALE spine entry's 'enumerated trust base' lists 4 residuals, omitting the Lean kernel+axioms (audit.sh/README/make-audit entry list 5)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: RATIONALE spine entry 'The enumerated trust base (the residuals — stated, never hidden)' lists exactly 4 items: S-intent, Z3/Verus, Rust-Lean correspondence, rustc/LLVM. It omits the Lean kernel + its 3 standard axioms — the very checker the entry leans on. scripts/audit.sh check [6] (RESIDUAL TRUST block), README check [6], and RATIONALE's own make-audit entry all enumerate 5, with the Lean kernel as item 1. The one entry whose job is enumerating trust under-enumerates it: both an internal contradiction and a limits-section-that-flatters.
